question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score AS stack_test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
condition_counts AS (
    SELECT s.name,
           SUM(CASE WHEN n.max_non_stack_test_score < s.stack_test_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cond_count
    FROM stack_scores s
    JOIN non_stack_max n ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version AND s.step = n.step
    WHERE s.step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY s.name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS sol_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT c.name, c.cond_count, s.sol_count
FROM condition_counts c
JOIN solution_counts s ON c.name = s.name
WHERE c.cond_count > s.sol_count
ORDER BY c.name
